name: Standup Notes
description: Turns the standup you just had into notes and commitments you will actually keep.

permissions.reason: To read the transcript of the meeting you just left.
To save the notes and commitments it extracts back to your memory.
To summarise the meeting using your own agent and your own model.
To read the commitments back to you when you ask.

triggers.description: Summarise the most recent meeting into decisions and commitments.
